summary.text: Seven Kills Rainbow is an immortal killer move named when Fang Yuan fights Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

claims.text: In Primordial Domain, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable sees Fang Yuan’s main body and points at him. Hundreds of deep blue stars shoot toward Fang Yuan. Fang Yuan shouts, his whole body emitting seven-colored radiance. Immortal killer move seven kills rainbow is named. Metal path yellow light, wood path jade-green light, water path light blue hue, fire path red light, earth path brown light, wind path green radiance, and lightning path deep blue light mix together and shoot forward in a drill shape. The seven kills rainbow destroys most of the stars and continues toward Star Constellation Immortal Venerable. Starlight around her blocks the killer move, but she still staggers.

It is a compound killer move, modified from five technique rainbow. Fang Yuan once used five technique rainbow in Eastern Sea when the Righteous Qi Alliance attacked Xia clan headquarters to retrieve Xia clan’s lost territory. Five technique rainbow used metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. Seven kills rainbow adds swift wind and violent lightning. Many killer moves only seem to involve many paths. When Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable fought Limitless’ will in Crazed Demon Cave, he used a killer move that imitated other paths’ strength. The essence was still one path, and only theft path needed to be targeted. Seven kills rainbow genuinely contains the strength of seven paths.

Immortal killer move seven kills rainbow is named. Fang Yuan pushes with his palm as a rainbow light shoots out. The rainbow light expands by tens of times its original size. The huge heavenly beam sweeps around and destroys all of the surrounding soul smoke. After getting a clear path, Fang Yuan raises his speed and breaks out of the soul smoke.
